description_expanded: OverviewPRIVATE BEACH - Gulf Peeks - Newly renovated - Bikes included - 7 PalmsThe SpaceWelcome to 7 Palms! Brand new to the rental market, newly renovated, gated community and private beach access. Yes, you read that right - private beach access! A rare gem in the 30A area!The amenities are endless in this complex! As soon as you enter through the gate, you are in paradise. The private beach access is just a quick walk from the back patio of the unit. Also, right outside is a large green area with grills, benches and a beautiful common space. The ground level of the condo unit includes ample parking, an outdoor shower and a few beach chairs to bring to and from the beach!When you enter the unit, you are greeted by the large open living, kitchen and dining floor plan. The first floor also includes a washer/dryer and access to a large balcony that overlooks the luscious green area. Make your way up to the second floor and two bedrooms await. The Master bedroom boasts a King-sized bed with private bathroom and private balcony with a gulf peekaboo. The guest bedroom includes two twin beds with a large shared bathroom.What more could you ask for? Come spend your vacation at 7 Palms and enjoy a vacation of a lifetime!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS (4):Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private bathroomGuest Bedroom - Twi twin sized beds, shared bathroomHOME HIGHLIGHTS:* Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service* PRIVATE Beach access* Newly renovated* Wifi* 2 Adult Bikes* Gulf Peek-a-boo* 2 designated parking spotsAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
